notes: Fab org_intel: the acknowledgement credits Intel's Fab11x for chip fabrication (p.1 Acknowledgement); the abstract and Implementation call the PIC an Intel Fab11x photonic IC (p.1). 'Intel Fab11x' is a registry alias of org_intel (unit_printed, fab site; ofc2026:Tu3C.2 precedent). process_name empty: the printed wording names a fab site, not a process, node or PDK (Contract v7; audit 2026-11-11 Q2). Laser material and integration method not stated: platform empty (D422). Output power, SMSR, linewidth and bias currents not reported. Each MRM and each ring add-drop filter locks to its own laser through a thermal control unit (p.1 Sec. E). Host EO row levy2026-a holds the spacing and laser lines only in its notes, so they are entered here (rule 2). The 8-lambda arrays of lit:levy2026 and ofc2026:Tu3C.2 are separate rows; this paper states no link to them.
